entities.name: Léon Gloden

entities.summary: Léon Marie Joseph Gloden is a Luxembourgish politician and lawyer who serves as Minister for Home Affairs since 2023. A member of the Christian Social People's Party, he was previously mayor of Grevenmacher and a member of the Chamber of Deputies from 2009 to 2023.
